entries.title: Systematic debugging
entries.use: Use when a failure needs reproduction and a supported root cause before choosing a fix.
entries.localGuidance: Reproduce the symptom, identify a discriminating check, and verify the smallest relevant correction. Do not treat a plausible cause as an observed one.

entries.title: GitHub MCP server
entries.use: Consider when a configured GitHub connection adds useful issue or review evidence beyond existing tools.
entries.localGuidance: Compare the selected connection with existing GitHub tooling before adding it. Verify its actual tool inventory and granted account permissions; a filter is not an authorization boundary.

entries.title: Context7 versioned documentation
entries.use: Consider when a library version matters and primary documentation is missing from the current evidence.
entries.localGuidance: Identify the package and version before retrieving documentation. Preserve the source and report missing or conflicting version evidence. Tool names and hosted access must be probed on the actual connection.

entries.title: Playwright browser workflows
entries.use: Consider for reproducible interaction checks in an isolated browser context.
entries.localGuidance: Check a real user path with controlled state. Separate screenshots, tested interactions, viewport reflow and accessibility evidence; none automatically establishes the others.
